PARTIAL: STATUS: partial
CHANGES: Added task execution attempt history model, CLI/RPC/REST list-show-respawn surfaces, respawn prompt construction with task body/last report/lane/model/report command, and attempt updates on assignment/report. Regenerated docs/CLI manifest and updated docs/API. Split oversized touched tests into focused modules.
BUILD/TYPECHECK/TESTS: cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml plan_task_attempts_and_respawn_parse: pass; cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml plugin_subcommands_parse: pass; cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml cmd::manifest: pass; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml task_attempt_history_builds_respawn_prompt_from_prior_attempt: pass using temporary dist/index.html plus existing bundle stub helpers for Tauri build-script resources; git diff --check: pass; bash scripts/check-file-sizes.sh still reports pre-existing oversized files outside this lane (provider-codex plugin.ts, js_runtime/provider.rs, keepawake.rs) while touched oversized test files are now under 1000 lines.
FOLLOWUP: in_review report was refused by report_guard because the lane has uncommitted changes and I cannot commit without explicit user request. Review whether Cargo.lock version refresh from 1.6.0 to 1.6.1 should be kept; it matches current crate manifests and was produced by cargo.

IN_REVIEW: STATUS: in_review
CHANGES: Committed 52ac23c9 (feat: respawn workers from task history). Added append-only task execution attempts, CLI/socket/REST attempts list-show-respawn surfaces, respawn prompt construction with task body/last report/lane/model/exact report command, and attempt updates on assignment/report. Updated generated CLI docs/manifest and API docs. Split touched oversized tests into focused modules; lockfile version-only noise restored and excluded.
BUILD/TYPECHECK/TESTS: git status --short clean; git diff --check pass; cargo fmt for cli and src-tauri run before commit; post-commit tests passed: cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml plan_task_attempts_and_respawn_parse; cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml plugin_subcommands_parse; cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml cmd::manifest; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml task_attempt_history_builds_respawn_prompt_from_prior_attempt (with temporary dist/index.html plus bundle stub helpers for Tauri build-script resources, removed afterward).
FOLLOWUP: Residual risk: full src-tauri test suite/build not run per lane constraint; file-size script still reports pre-existing unrelated oversized files outside this lane (provider-codex plugin.ts, js_runtime/provider.rs, keepawake.rs).

IN_REVIEW: STATUS: in_review
CHANGES: Amended c3b08f1c to use canonical Task.execution_attempts/TaskExecutionAttempt for task history; CLI/API attempts/list/show/respawn now select by executor_pane_id-derived attempt_id, derive prompt/report_command at response time, and append a new canonical execution_attempt for respawns. Report body is stored narrowly on TaskExecutionReportSnapshot.message so respawn prompts include prior report text/status. No Task.attempts duplicate schema remains.
BUILD/TYPECHECK/TESTS: git status --short clean; git diff --check passed; cargo fmt for cli and src-tauri; cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml plan_task_attempts_and_respawn_parse passed; cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml cmd::manifest passed; node scripts/prepare-cli-stub.js && node scripts/prepare-embed-stub.js && mkdir -p dist && touch dist/index.html && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml task_attempt_history_builds_respawn_prompt_from_prior_attempt passed, dist removed after run.
FOLLOWUP: Backend merge should preserve TaskExecutionReportSnapshot.message or another canonical report-body slot; no Cargo.lock noise included.
Accepted into feat/canvas-updates: executor history persists, respawn CLI/API added, UI separates historical executor from live presence; focused TS/CLI/Rust gates passed.
